status.description: Saga state derived from the journal. 'accepted' is the eventual-consistency gap: the order has been enrolled in the saga journal but the projection Tailer has not yet applied any saga event for it (no read-model row exists yet); clients should poll until the status transitions to a non-accepted value. 'running' means at least one forward or compensation step event has been applied. 'succeeded', 'compensated', and 'failed' are terminal absorbing states.
